title: Path-AGNN-Cox: a reproducible statistical framework for testing patient-specific pathway rewiring in cancer survival analysis
description: Pathway-constrained adaptive graph neural network with per-patient attention edge weights and a Cox survival head, together with statistical testing machinery for patient-specific pathway rewiring (label-permutation nulls, static-model and standard-GAT controls, matched random gene-set controls). Benchmarked on 11 TCGA cancer types with 25 independent GEO external validation cohorts.
